item.name: Ampersand Check if a Domain is Claimed

request.name: Ampersand Check if a Domain is Claimed

description.content: Returns claimed domain information if authenticated user is an owner of the organization that claimed the domain, or if the user's email domain matches the claimed domain.

query.description: (Required) Accepts an email address, domain name, or URL. The domain will be automatically extracted: for emails, the portion after @ is used (e.g., "user@example.com" becomes "example.com"); for URLs, the hostname is extracted (e.g., "https://www.example.com" becomes "example.com").
